response.original_title: Dundas Desert Trees: A Men's League Basketball Documentary
response.overview: DUNDAS DESERT TREES follows a group of friends through the highs, lows, heartbreak and questionable decision-making that come with taking rec basketball far more seriously than anyone probably should.  Part sports documentary, part comedy, the film tells the true story of the Desert Trees — their history, their players, their repeated trips to the Finals, and their pursuit of the championship that continued to elude them.  It’s a story about basketball, friendship, failure, perseverance and what happens when a men’s league team starts to believe there might actually be something worth playing for.  DUNDAS DESERT TREES  A documentary by Ben Little
